title: Loop 4 — Directional Bias: kill hamburger / plus
meta: A Two-Inlet Route · B Hard Offset · C Staggered Dock · D Weight Bias. Teal only down+out. Open lowercase ctx from loop 3D.

items.name: Two-Inlet Route
items.blurb: Drop one flank. Short upper + long middle. Teal runs only down from the junction, then out.

items.name: Hard Offset
items.blurb: Three inlets remain. No teal above the long-inlet junction. Pipe hangs down and out.

items.name: Staggered Dock
items.blurb: Flanks stop short at different x. Only the middle inlet meets the teal stdout.

items.name: Weight Bias
items.blurb: Heavy primary route (middle + teal). Flanks materially lighter and shorter.
